codeReview.summary: CRITICAL: Worker implemented an entirely wrong feature. The assigned feature 'foundation-vector-embeddings' required fixing the vector embedding pipeline (pgvector similarity search, Ollama nomic-embed-text, NullEmbeddings fallback, embedding tests). Instead, the worker implemented Fernet encryption for API keys stored in system_knowledge (core/utils/crypto.py, modified database.py get_pref/set_pref/upsert, startup migration, 26 crypto tests). Zero embedding-related files were touched in commit 635d1a3. None of the 5 expectedBehavior items were addressed. Neither of the 2 verificationSteps were executed. The handoff explicitly states 'Implemented Fernet symmetric encryption for API keys' confirming the wrong feature was built.

issues.description: File was never modified. The feature description explicitly states 'Update the embedding provider in core/memory/context.py to correctly generate embeddings' — this was not done.

No embedding provider changes were made in this commit. The feature required fixing the embedding pipeline (Ollama nomic-embed-text, vector dimensions, NullEmbeddings fallback). None of this was implemented.

No embedding tests were created. The feature required 'Write tests' for storing/retrieving memories with embeddings and cosine similarity search. Instead, test_crypto.py was written for the wrong feature.
This entire file implements API key encryption — a completely different feature from vector embeddings. The worker appears to have confused the feature assignment or worked on the wrong task.

The commit includes numerous unrelated schema additions beyond the crypto work: PendingApproval table, SkillMetrics table, Alert.create() override with email notification, LLMUsage.get_since(), Command.response column. These suggest the worker committed accumulated unstaged changes from other sessions alongside their own work, indicating poor git hygiene.
